chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan from Sindi ibn Rabi' from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from a man from our companions who said:

I heard him say: 'It is not permissible for anyone to combine two from the children of Fatimah (peace be upon her), for that reaches her and becomes burdensome for her.' I said: 'It reaches her?' He said: 'Yes, by Allah.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on marrying two descendants of Fatimah to one man according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the permissibility of polygyny specifically within the progeny of Fatimah al-Zahra (peace be upon her), a ruling unique to the Ahl al-Bayt due to their elevated spiritual status. The mechanism of 'news reaching her' (balagha) is interpreted by Shia scholars as either a miraculous awareness or a natural consequence of her high rank, causing her distress if two of her sons were married to one man, thereby preserving the distinct honor of her lineage.
